items.source:
A factory to create projecting instances for other objects usually used to allow easy creation of representation
projections to define which properties of a domain objects shall be exported in which way.
items.translation: 工厂用于为其他对象创建投影实例，通常用来方便地定义表示投影，以指定域对象的哪些属性应以何种方式导出。

items.source: Descriptor for a property-level type along its potential projection that is held within a Collection-like or Map-like container.
items.translation: 描述沿其潜在投影在类似 Collection 或类似 Map 的容器中持有的属性级类型的描述符。

items.source: Represents a predicate (boolean-valued function) of a target type and its underlying type.
items.translation: 表示一个目标类型及其底层类型的谓词（布尔值函数）。

items.source: SPI to create MethodInterceptor instances based on the given source object and the target type to produce.
items.translation: SPI 用于根据给定的源对象和要生成的目标类型创建 MethodInterceptor 实例。

items.source: Ahead-of-Time (AOT) generation for Spring Data repositories.
items.translation: Spring Data 存储库的提前生成（AOT）。

items.source: Base classes to implement repositories for various data stores.
items.translation: 用于实现各种数据存储库的基础类。

items.source: Support classes to work with query methods.
items.translation: 提供用于配合查询方法的辅助类。

items.source: Descriptor for a top-level mapped type representing a view onto a domain type structure.
items.translation: 描述表示对域类型结构视图的顶层映射类型的描述符。

items.source: Descriptor for a property-level type along its potential projection.
items.translation: 描述属性级类型在其潜在投影上的元数据。

items.source:
This class introspects the returned type in the context of a domain type for all reachable properties (w/o cycles) to
determine which property paths are subject to projection.
items.translation: 该类将在域类型的上下文中，对所有可达属性（无循环）进行内省，以确定哪些属性路径适用于投影。
